INSERT INTO core.notice (content_et, content_en, severity, pages, is_dismissible, valid_from, valid_to, sort_order) VALUES (#{notice.contentEt}, #{notice.contentEn}, #{notice.severity}, #{notice.pages,javaType=java.util.List}, #{notice.dismissible}, #{notice.validFrom}, #{notice.validTo}, (SELECT coalesce(max(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM core.notice)) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE core.notice SET content_et = #{notice.contentEt}, content_en = #{notice.contentEn}, severity = #{notice.severity}, pages = #{notice.pages,javaType=java.util.List}, is_dismissible = #{notice.dismissible}, valid_from = #{notice.validFrom}, valid_to = #{notice.validTo} WHERE id = #{notice.id}

UPDATE core.notice n SET sort_order = ordered.new_sort_order FROM (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sort_order) AS new_sort_order FROM core.notice) ordered WHERE n.id = ordered.id AND n.sort_order <> ordered.new_sort_order
